attendance_records_override_reason.name: attendance_records_override_reason

attendance_geofence_radius.name: attendance_geofence_radius
attendance_geofence_radius.value: radius_m is null or radius_m between 10 and 5000

exam_marks_absent_has_no_score.name: exam_marks_absent_has_no_score
exam_marks_absent_has_no_score.value: not absent or obtained is null

library_loans_returned_after_issue.name: library_loans_returned_after_issue
library_loans_returned_after_issue.value: returned_at is null or returned_at >= issued_at

library_titles_year.name: library_titles_year
library_titles_year.value: year is null or (year between 1400 and 2200)
